claim_text: 來源機構：British Journal of Educational Technology（Wiley）；資料標題：Generative AI empowered contextual educational games as facilitators of elementary school students' computational thinking tendencies；來源刊登日：2026-11-13。作者摘要報告：研究開發生成式 AI 賦能的情境教育遊戲環境，並以中國東部一所小學兩個五年級原班進行準實驗研究；作者說明，因運算思維傾向以自陳方式測量、介入只進行 3 週教學、樣本來自單一學校，研究結果宜審慎解讀。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: Generative AI empowered contextual educational games as facilitators of elementary school students' computational thinking tendencies
title_zh: 生成式 AI 賦能的情境教育遊戲作為小學生運算思維傾向的促進工具
source_locator: 出版社文章頁截圖（管理者 2026-11-18 提供；自動讀取回 403）：First published: 13 November 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 4、5、9 句
original_excerpt: To address this challenge, a generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-empowered contextual gaming environment was developed. … A quasi-experimental study was conducted with two intact fifth-grade classes at an elementary school in eastern China. … These findings should be interpreted cautiously because CT tendencies were measured through self-report, the intervention lasted 3 instructional weeks, and the sample was drawn from a single school.

summary_evidence_spans: To address this challenge, a generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-empowered contextual gaming environment was developed.
A quasi-experimental study was conducted with two intact fifth-grade classes at an elementary school in eastern China.
These findings should be interpreted cautiously because CT tendencies were measured through self-report, the intervention lasted 3 instructional weeks, and the sample was drawn from a single school.
